title.zh: 将南甘马粦省 Minalabac 市镇 Bagolatao 描笼涯的 Villamayor 国立中学的 Bagolatao 附属校分离，改设为独立的同名国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Villamayor National High School-Bagolatao Annex in Barangay Bagolatao, Municipality of Minalabac, Province of Camarines Sur from the Villamayor National High School Converting it into an Independent National High School to be Known as Bagolatao National High School, and Appropriating Fund Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Villamayor National High School-Bagolatao Annex in Barangay Bagolatao, Municipality of Minalabac, Province of Camarines Sur from the Villamayor National High School Converting it into an Independent National High School to be Known as Bagolatao National High School, and Appropriating Fund Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Bagolatao của Trường Trung học Villamayor Quốc gia tại Barangay Bagolatao, Đô thị Minalabac, Tỉnh Camarines Sur khỏi Trường Trung học Villamayor Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Bagolatao Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Bagolatao ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Villamayor แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Bagolatao เทศบาล Minalabac จังหวัด Camarines Sur ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Villamayor แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Bagolatao แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Bagolatao, Sekolah Menengah Villamayor Nasional di Barangay Bagolatao, Kotamadya Minalabac, Provinsi Camarines Sur dari Sekolah Menengah Villamayor Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Bagolatao Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Bagolatao, Sekolah Menengah Villamayor Kebangsaan di Barangay Bagolatao, Perbandaran Minalabac, Wilayah Camarines Sur daripada Sekolah Menengah Villamayor Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Bagolatao Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The Villamayor National High School - Bagolatao Annex in Barangay Bagolatao, Municipality of Minalabac, Province of Camarines Sur is hereby separated from the Villamayor National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Bagolatao National High School
All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Villamayor National High School - Bagolatao Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Bagolatao National High School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Bagolatao National High School, the initial funding of which be charged against the current year's appropriation of the Villamayor National High School - Bagolatao Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
The Secretary of Education shall formulate the rules and regulations necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act within one hundred twenty (120) days after its effectivity.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
